definitions.gloss: along a railway line, area along a train line
definitions.explanation: The areas and neighborhoods located along a particular railway line.

examples.japanese: {沿線|えんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live along the train line.

examples.japanese: {中央線|ちゅうおうせん}{沿線|えんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a place to live along the Chuo Line.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{沿線|えんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{花見客|はなみきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧。
examples.english: There are many famous cherry blossom spots along this line, and it gets crowded with flower viewers in spring.

notes:
USAGE: Very common in real estate, commuting, and travel contexts in Japan. Often used with a specific line name: 〜⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧{沿線|えんせん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧{沿線|えんせん}: along the ~ Line
- {沿線|えんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: residents along the line
- {沿線|えんせん}⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: residents along the line
- {沿線|えんせん}マップ: guide map of areas along a train line

CULTURE: In Japanese cities, neighborhoods are often identified by which train line they're on. Real estate ads frequently specify the railway line, making {沿線|えんせん} a key concept for apartment hunting.
